title: ConfigurationValue
description: Authoritative field-level payload schema for the ConfigurationValue family of UCOS-DATA-CONTRACT-018 (API-018 Configuration & Metadata). A ConfigurationValue is the resolved, layered configuration for a scope (LD-17 / PD-17 Platform; PDE-070 Configuration Set). Field authority: UCOS-PDATA-ARCH-001. Fields are derived from the implemented Configuration substrate (ConfigurationPort, configuration-runtime, EV-PI23-BUILD VERIFIED) and API-018 operation intent. Classification is inherited at the domain level (MC-01) and is not a payload field. Transport form deferred to Prompt 08; security controls deferred to Prompt 09.

schema.description: One configuration value or resolved configuration set for a scope.
Configuration scope selector. Source authority: API-018 GET /configuration/{scope} (UCOS-CONTRACT-CAT-001 §A).
Specific configuration key within the scope, present when addressing a single value. Source authority: API-018 PUT /configuration/{scope}/{key}.
Owning capability the configuration applies to (CAP-10). Source authority: ConfigurationPort — values are stored and resolved per capabilityId (meta-core/ports.ts, configuration-store.ts).
Resolution layer contributing this value; layers deep-merge in order (later wins). Source authority: ConfigurationPort DEFAULT_LAYER_ORDER (configuration-store.ts).

The effective configuration value/set. Open object: an arbitrary structured configuration map. Source authority: ConfigurationPort.resolve → Record<string, unknown> (configuration-store.ts). Interior shape is capability-defined, not redefined here.
